blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments. We present Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a closed-loop manipulation framework that learns how manipulation unfolds through video prediction and recovers executable motion through geometric estimation. Our key idea is to represent robot motion through wrist-camera trajectories, which determine the corresponding end-effector poses through a fixed hand-eye transformation. We pair a video generator that predicts future wrist views with a pose estimator adapted from a pretrained 3D model to recover the corresponding camera trajectories. Model stitching maps the generator's predicted latents directly into the estimator's intermediate feature space, bypassing RGB decoding. This decomposition allows task knowledge to expand through broad human and robot video data while reusing geometric motion estimation across tasks and embodiments. The resulting pose estimator transfers across Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro without further fine-tuning. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, WVP generalizes to tasks ranging from precise grasping and inserting to handling deformable objects, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluations. Our project page is at https://wrist-video-policy.github.io.
blocks.zh: 通用的操纵政策应执行新的任务,在不熟悉的场景中运作,在机器人的身上传授技能。 我们提出Wrist Video Policy(WVP),这是一个闭路操纵框架,它学习如何通过视频预测进行操纵,并通过几何估计恢复可执行的运动. 我们的关键想法是通过手腕-相机轨迹来代表机器人运动,通过固定的手眼转变来决定相应的末端效应器. 我们把一个预测未来腕部视图的视频生成器与从预先训练的3D模型中改编的姿势估计器配对,以恢复相应的相机轨迹. 模型将生成器的预测潜伏物直接缝合到估计器的中间特征空间,绕过RGB解码. 这种分解使得任务知识能够通过广泛的人和机器人视频数据扩展,同时重新使用跨任务和浮雕的几何运动估计. 由此形成的构型是Franca Panda,PiPER-X,以及Galaxea R1 Pro的互换,无需进一步微调. 跨台式和洗衣房设置,WVP概括到从精确抓取和插入到处理可变形物体的任务,在零射出分配评价中成功率超过50%. 我们的项目网页见https://wrist-video-policy.github.io。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Generalization in robotic manipulation requires policies to perform new tasks and transfer familiar skills across scenes and robot embodiments [ 12 ] . Vision-language-action (VLA) models combine pretrained visual and linguistic knowledge with robot demonstrations, enabling manipulation across diverse tasks, environments, and embodiments [ 8 , 5 , 22 ] . Scaling these capabilities through action-labeled demonstrations, however, creates an expensive coverage problem, as the training data must capture a broad range of tasks, environments, and robot motions. Video-based approaches, including world-action models (WAMs), offer a way to learn much of this task and interaction knowledge from a broader supply of human and robot videos, without requiring corresponding action labels for video pretraining [ 52 , 63 ] . Recent advances demonstrate the potential of this approach through transfer from human videos and zero-shot execution of new tasks [ 41 , 20 ] . Yet learning to faithfully translate visual predictions into executable motion still typically requires action-labeled robot trajectories [ 55 , 20 ] .
Even with this reliance on action labels, separating task knowledge from motion execution opens a promising path to scalable robot learning.
blocks.zh:
机器人操纵的通俗化要求政策执行新任务,将熟悉的技能跨场景和机器人的化身相传[12]. Vision-language-Action(VLA)模型将预先训练的视觉和语言知识与机器人演示结合起来,使不同的任务,环境,和相传的化身相通[8,5,22]. 然而,通过以行动标记的演示来增强这些能力,造成了一个昂贵的覆盖问题,因为培训数据必须涵盖广泛的任务、环境和机器人运动。 基于视频的方法,包括世界行动模型(WAMs),提供了一个从更广泛的人和机器人视频供应中学习大部分这项任务和互动知识的方法,而不需要相应的行动标签进行视频预训[52,63]. 最近的进展表明,通过从人类视频中传输和零发执行新任务[41、20],这种做法具有潜力。 然而,学会忠实地将视觉预测转化为可执行的运动,仍然通常需要动作标记的机器人轨迹[55,20].
即使如此依赖动作标签,将任务知识与运动执行相分离,也为可伸缩的机器人学习开辟了一条有希望的道路.

blocks.en: Building on this separation, we aim to achieve zero-shot transfer across tasks, scenes, and embodiments without additional action-labeled demonstrations for deployment. A natural foundation for this goal is the 3D geometry of manipulation. Different robots may need different joint commands to approach and manipulate an object, but their motion can be described in the same way across embodiments by how far the gripper moves and how it is oriented relative to the object. Recent policies incorporate 3D scene features into action prediction [ 23 , 40 ] , but still rely on robot demonstrations to learn the mapping from geometry to actions, limiting zero-shot generalization across tasks, scenes, and embodiments. Pretrained 3D models, on the other hand, suggest a more direct role for geometry. They can already estimate camera poses from images across diverse scenes and viewpoints [ 49 , 32 , 50 ] . Treating motion execution as a well-defined geometric estimation problem could extend these pretrained capabilities to robot control and, together with video prediction, provide a scalable path towards learning manipulation in 3D visual space.
blocks.zh: 在这种分离的基础上,我们的目标是实现在任务、场景和表现上零发的转移,而不进行附加行动标记的示威部署。 这个目标的自然基础是操纵的3D几何. 不同的机器人可能需要不同的联合命令来接近并操纵一个物体,但是它们的运动可以同样地被描述为跨越了活化体,用钳子移动多远以及它相对于物体的取向. 近期的政策将3D场景特征融入了动作预测[23,40],但仍然依靠机器人演示来从几何学到动作来学习绘图,限制了零镜头泛指任务,场景,并表现. 另一方面,预先训练的3D模型则暗示出更直接的几何作用. 他们已经可以估计来自不同场景和观点的相机[49、32、50]。 将运动执行视为一个定义明确的几何估计问题,可以将这些被预先训练的能力扩展至机器人控制,并和视频预测一起为3D视觉空间的学习操纵提供可伸缩的路径.

blocks.en: A wrist-mounted camera makes this idea concrete by connecting video prediction with geometric estimation. Because it is rigidly attached to the end effector, their poses are related by a fixed hand-eye transformation. We can therefore plan the robot’s motion by predicting future wrist-camera views, estimating the camera trajectory, and converting it into end-effector poses for execution. The prediction target remains the motion of the observing camera regardless of which robot carries it, allowing the same estimator to transfer across embodiments through each robot’s hand-eye calibration. This lets task knowledge expand through video prediction while reusing the geometric mechanism that translates those predictions into actions.
blocks.zh: 手腕架相机通过将视频预测与几何估计相接而来,使这个想法变得具体. 由于它被刚性地附着到终端效应器上,它们的外观由固定的手眼转变来相通. 因此,我们可以通过预测未来手腕-相机的视线、估计相机轨迹以及将其转换成最终效果器来规划机器人的运动。 预测目标仍然是观察相机的移动,而不管该相机携带的是哪个机器人,让同一个估计器通过每个机器人的手眼校正来跨出浮雕. 这可以让任务知识通过视频预测来扩展,同时再用将这些预测转化为行动的几何机制.

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce Wrist Video Policy (WVP) , a policy that connects pretrained video and 3D models through wrist-camera motion. Given a language instruction and current observations, the generator predicts how wrist views will evolve, drawing on pretrained video models that generalize across manipulation tasks and scenes [ 29 , 20 ] . The pose estimator builds on a pretrained 3D model [ 49 ] , whose geometric priors we adapt to robot control through fine-tuning on public wrist-camera videos and trajectories. Once adapted, it is reused across tasks and embodiments without further fine-tuning. We then connect the two components through model stitching [ 19 ] , mapping the predicted video latents directly into the estimator’s intermediate feature space. This bypasses RGB decoding and yields action trajectories that more closely follow the visual plan.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了Wrist Video Policy(WVP),这个政策通过手腕相机运动连接了预先训练的视频和3D模型. 鉴于语言指示和当前观察,生成器预测手腕视图将如何演化,取而代之的是经过预先训练的将操纵任务和场景概括的视频模型[29,20]. 姿势估测器基于一种预先训练过的3D模型[49],其几何前缀通过微调公共手腕相机视频和轨迹来适应机器人控制. 一旦经过改造,它便在任务和浮雕之间重复使用,而不作进一步的微调。 然后我们通过模型缝合[19]将两个组件连接起来,将预测的视频潜伏物直接映射到估计器的中间特征空间. 这绕过RGB解码并产生更紧密地遵循视觉计划的动作轨迹.

blocks.en: We evaluate WVP on real robots across tasks, scenes, and embodiments. Trained solely on public robot datasets, the pose estimator transfers across all three settings without further fine-tuning. Paired with a video generator, it enables zero-shot manipulation with a success rate of over 50% in our out-of-distribution tests. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, the system performs tasks ranging from pick-and-place and stacking to wiping, inserting, retrieving clothes, and opening articulated fixtures. Its capabilities span fine-grained manipulation of small rigid objects, handling of deformable garments and towels, and precise stacking of transparent tableware (Fig. 3 ). In summary, our contributions are threefold. • We represent robot actions using wrist-camera motion, formulating action prediction as estimating the camera poses of future wrist-camera views. • We present a pose estimator built on a pretrained 3D model, and use model stitching to estimate wrist-camera motion directly from a video generator’s latents. • We demonstrate that WVP generalizes across tasks, scenes, and embodiments in the real world, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot evaluations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价WVP 真正的机器人 跨任务,场景,和浮雕。 仅接受公共机器人数据集培训,姿势估测器在所有三个场合进行转移,而无需作进一步的微调. 使用视频生成器,可以进行零镜头操纵 成功率超过50% 在我们的分发测试。 该系统在台上和洗衣房的设置上,执行的任务从取取地和堆放到擦拭、插入、取回衣服以及打开装有固定装置等。 其能力包括精细地操纵小型刚性物体、处理可变形的服装和毛巾以及精确地堆放透明餐具(图3)。 总而言之,我们的贡献有三重。 我们用手腕相机运动代表机器人动作,提出动作预测,作为对未来手腕相机视图的相机外观的估计. ^ 我们提出一个基于预先训练的3D模型的姿势估计器,并使用模型缝合来直接从视频生成器的潜伏物中估计出手腕-相机运动。 我们证明,妇女选民方案概括了现实世界的任务、场景和表现,实现了50%以上的零镜头评价成功率。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Generalization in Robotic Manipulation
blocks.zh: 2.1 机器人操纵中的通用化

blocks.en: Vision-language-action models combine pretrained visual and linguistic knowledge with robot demonstrations from diverse tasks and embodiments [ 8 , 25 , 6 ] . Recent approaches scale vision-language models for embodied perception and reasoning [ 45 , 44 ] , express robot motions in natural language to benefit from language pretraining [ 59 ] , or unify action spaces for joint training across embodiments [ 58 ] . Lower-cost data collection methods further support training across diverse settings [ 13 , 33 , 46 ] . These advances enable robots to manipulate unfamiliar objects [ 8 ] , perform household tasks in unseen homes [ 5 ] , and transfer familiar skills to new task–embodiment combinations [ 22 , 34 ] . However, existing low-cost data collection methods typically rely on shared end-effector configurations, limiting their applicability across heterogeneous robot platforms. Moreover, despite reduced collection costs, scaling action-labeled demonstrations across embodiments remains expensive, motivating the use of human and robot videos without corresponding action annotations.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型结合了预先训练的视觉和语言知识与来自不同任务和表现的机器人演示[8,25,6]. 近期的方针将视觉语言模型规模化,用于体现认知和推理[45,44],用自然语言表达机器人运动,以受益于语言预训[59],或统一跨表现形式的联合培训行动空间[58]. 成本较低的数据收集方法进一步支持各种环境的培训[13、33、46]。 这些进步使机器人能够操纵不熟悉的物体[8],在看不见的家里执行家庭任务[5],并将熟悉的技能转移到新的任务组合[22,34]。 然而,现有的低成本数据收集方法通常依赖于共享的终端效应配置,限制了它们在不同机器人平台上的可应用性. 此外,尽管收集成本降低,但将标有行动标签的演示推广到各化身仍然昂贵,促使人们使用人和机器人视频,而无需相应的行动说明。

blocks.en: World-action models learn from these videos by predicting future observations from earlier frames [ 52 , 9 ] . Scaling this pretraining has improved transfer from human videos to robot manipulation [ 4 , 41 , 57 ] and enabled zero-shot execution of new tasks [ 17 , 7 , 20 ] , but learning actual robot commands still typically requires action-labeled trajectories [ 55 , 20 ] . To reduce this dependence, some methods learn latent actions from unlabeled videos [ 56 , 62 ] or train an inverse dynamics model independently of the video backbone using task-agnostic robot exploration [ 43 , 29 , 60 ] . These approaches reduce the need for task-specific demonstrations, but do not fully eliminate the reliance on robot-action data [ 43 ] . Geometric methods instead derive robot trajectories from hand motion, object poses, or 3D object flow estimated from video [ 26 , 30 , 39 , 10 , 16 , 11 ] . However, estimating robot end-effector poses from object trajectories or hand poses often relies on accurate depth estimates and a clear view of the relevant motion, and errors in reconstructing that motion can propagate to the resulting robot trajectory. WVP instead represents robot actions using the motion of the wrist camera itself, and draws on the geometric priors of a pretrained 3D model to estimate that motion from video predictions. Each robot’s hand-eye calibration maps the estimated trajectory to end-effector targets, enabling zero-shot manipulation across embodiments.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型从这些视频中吸取了教训,预测了未来从更早的帧[52,9]的观测结果. 扩大这种预训改进了从人视频到机器人操纵的转移[4,41,57],并使得零发执行新任务[17,7,20],但学习实际的机器人指令仍然通常需要行动标记的轨迹[55,20]. 为了减少这种依赖,一些方法从无标签的视频[56,62]中学习出潜在的动作,或者利用任务不可知机器人探索[43,29,60],在视频主干线之外独立训练出反向动态模型. 这些方法减少了对特定任务演示的需要,但并没有完全消除对机器人动作数据的依赖[43]. 取而代之的是几何方法从手动,物体姿势,或从视频估计出3D物体流[26, 30, 39, 10, 16, 11]得到机器人的轨迹. 然而,从物体轨迹或手所摆出的估计机器人端效应器往往依赖于准确的深度估计和对相关运动的清晰的观察,而重建该运动出的错误会传播到由此产生的机器人轨迹. WVP取而代之是使用手腕相机本身的运动代表了机器人动作,并取自被预先训练的3D模型的几何前缀来从视频预测中估计出该运动. 每个机器人的手眼校正 绘制了最终效果目标的估计轨迹, 使得零发的操纵 跨越了浮雕。

blocks.en: 2.2 Model Stitching
blocks.zh: 2.2 型号剪接

blocks.en: Video generators encode how a scene will change in their latent representations, before any RGB frames are decoded. Model stitching enables reuse of these representations by learning a map from one model’s features to an intermediate layer of another. Originally used to study whether networks learn compatible representations [ 27 , 3 , 15 ] , stitching has since been used to combine pretrained components across architectures and modalities [ 54 , 38 , 42 , 36 ] . VIST3A [ 19 ] , for example, maps video latents into a pretrained 3D reconstruction network to generate scene geometry without video decoding. In robot control, video latents can also serve as inputs to action decoders that predict the commands needed to carry out a visual plan [ 21 , 37 , 31 , 20 ] . We connect these two ideas by stitching a video generator to a pose estimator built on a pretrained 3D model [ 49 ] , significantly improving performance in real-world manipulation.
blocks.zh: 在任何 RGB 框架解码之前, 视频生成器编码一个场景将如何改变其潜在的表达方式 。 模型缝合能够通过从一个模型的特征学到另一个中间层的地图来重新利用这些表示。 最初用于研究网络是否学习相兼容的表示 [27, 3, 15] , 缝合从此被用于将预先训练的组件组合到各种架构和模式[54, 38, 42, 36]. VIST3A [19] 例如将视频潜入预先训练的3D重建网络来生成场景几何而无需视频解码. 在机器人控制中,视频潜想也可以作为动作解码器的输入来预测执行视觉计划所需的指令[21,37,31,20]. 我们通过将一个视频生成器缝合到一个基于预先训练的3D模型[49]的姿势估计器来将这两个想法联系起来,大大地提高了现实世界操纵的性能.

blocks.en: We aim to develop a closed-loop robotic manipulation system that turns video predictions into executable actions. A wrist camera is related to the end effector by a fixed transformation, so its trajectory provides a geometric description of end-effector motion. We build on this relationship by combining a general video model with a 3D pose estimator. Given a language instruction and current observations, the video model predicts future wrist-camera observations, from which the pose estimator recovers the camera trajectory. This casts robot motion generation as a wrist-camera pose estimation problem. The recovered trajectory is converted into robot actions, and the system executes the action segment before re-planning from new observations.

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: WVP connects task knowledge from pretrained video models with geometric motion estimation from a pretrained 3D model through wrist-camera trajectories. We first adapt the 3D model on public robot videos paired with wrist-camera trajectories and gripper states, yielding an RGB pose estimator that can be reused across tasks, scenes, and embodiments (Sec. 4.1 ). We then use model stitching to map the generator’s predicted video latents into the estimator’s intermediate feature space, enabling motion estimation without RGB decoding (Sec. 4.2 ). At deployment, the estimated camera trajectories are converted into end-effector targets through the robot’s hand-eye calibration and executed with the predicted gripper states in a closed loop (Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: WVP通过手腕相机轨迹将来自被预先训练的视频模型的任务知识与从预先训练的3D模型得到的几何运动估计相接. 我们首先在与手腕相机轨迹和抓取状态相配的公共机器人视频上修改了3D模型,生成一个RGB的外观估计器,可以跨任务,场景和浮雕重用(Sec 4.1)。 然后我们用模型缝合将生成器的预测视频潜入到估计器的中间特性空间,从而可以在没有RGB解码的情况下进行运动估计(第4.2节)。 在部署时,估计相机轨迹通过机器人的手眼校正被转换成最终效果目标,并用预想的抓取器状态以闭环(Sec 4.3.

Camera poses are obtained from dataset annotations or reconstructed from robot states and camera calibrations, with base motion taken into account when expressing poses in a moving robot base. We unify camera-axis conventions across datasets and express each wrist-camera trajectory relative to its first frame, using world-to-camera transforms as supervision following VGGT [ 49 ] . Specifically, given camera poses C i = T W ← C i C_{i}=T_{W\leftarrow C_{i}} in a fixed reference frame W W , the supervision target is Q i = C i − 1 ​ C 0 = P i − 1 Q_{i}=C_{i}^{-1}C_{0}=P_{i}^{-1} , where C 0 C_{0} is the first-frame pose and P i P_{i} is the camera-to-first-frame transformation defined in Sec. 3 . blocks.en: To transfer the expert’s motion estimation capabilities to latent inputs, we distill the frozen RGB pose estimator into the stitched student using the training videos from Sec. 4.1 . We encode the training videos with the frozen VAE encoder, following the generator’s view layout and preprocessing. The student takes these latents as input and learns to match the camera-pose and gripper predictions produced by the RGB expert at corresponding time steps, requiring no additional action labels. We jointly optimize the adapter, the retained backbone, and both prediction heads to adapt the pretrained representation to latent inputs while preserving the expert’s geometric capabilities (Fig. 2(a) , top).
blocks.zh: 为了将专家的运动估计能力转移到潜在的投入,我们利用第4.1节的训练录像,将被冻结的RGB定型为被缝合的学生。 我们用被冻结的VAE编码器编码训练录像, 学生将这些潜伏物作为输入,并学习与RGB专家在相应时间步骤上生成的相机-pose and griper预测相匹配,不需要额外的动作标签. 我们共同优化适配器、保留的主干线以及两个预测头,在保留专家几何能力(图2(a),顶部)的同时,使预先训练过的表示方式适应潜在投入。

blocks.en:
At each planning step, the video generator conditions on the current observations, encoded by its VAE encoder ε \varepsilon , and the language instruction to predict video latents for M M future time steps (Fig. 2(a) , bottom).
The stitched pose estimator takes the current and predicted wrist-view latents and estimates camera trajectories and gripper states for each arm. We invert each predicted world-to-camera transform to obtain the relative camera pose P ^ i = Q ^ i − 1 \hat{P}_{i}=\hat{Q}_{i}^{-1} , then apply the robot’s hand-eye calibration through Eq. ( 1 ) to obtain the end-effector target. Inverse kinematics converts these targets into joint configurations. The robot executes the first K K actions with the corresponding gripper commands before replanning from updated observations. The execution horizon K K balances feedback responsiveness and inference cost. A shorter execution horizon enables earlier correction of execution errors at the cost of more frequent inference.

blocks.en: We evaluate WVP’s ability to turn video predictions into executable actions across tasks, scenes, and embodiments. We first examine real-world manipulation with a pose estimator reused across these settings without further fine-tuning, including demonstrations of recovery from execution disturbances (Sec. 5.1 ). We then compare WVP with existing robot-control approaches to assess its task success rates (Sec. 5.2 ). Finally, we analyze how video prediction, adaptation of the pretrained 3D model, and latent-space stitching affect the accuracy of motion estimation and the success of task execution (Sec. 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价WVP将视频预测转化为跨任务、场景和表现的可执行行动的能力。 我们首先审查真实世界的操纵情况,用一个姿势估计器在不作进一步微调的情况下重复使用,包括展示从执行干扰中恢复的情况(第5.1条)。 然后,我们将WVP与现有的机器人控制方法进行比较,以评估其任务成功率(第5.2条)。 最后,我们分析视频预测、对预先训练的3D模型的调整以及潜在的空间缝合如何影响运动估计的准确性和任务执行的成功(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Real-World Manipulation
blocks.zh: 5.1 现实世界操纵

blocks.en: We evaluate WVP on Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro, with their camera configurations shown in Fig. 3 a. 1 1 1 Hereafter, we refer to Franka Panda and Galaxea R1 Pro as Franka and Galaxea, respectively. Unless otherwise specified, all experiments use the same stitched VGGT pose estimator trained as described in Sec. 4.2 , without further fine-tuning. The video generator is used directly on Franka and PiPER-X, and adapted using only RGB recordings of the target tasks on Galaxea. The evaluation covers 12 tasks across tabletop manipulation on Franka and PiPER-X and laundry-room manipulation on Galaxea, including pick-and-place, opening, inserting, grasping, stacking, and wiping. These tasks pose different challenges. Grasping a pen and a basketball requires different gripper states. Opening a washing machine door or a drawer requires handling articulated fixtures. Handling clothes and towels requires maintaining a valid grasp as they deform.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了弗兰卡·熊猫,PiPER-X和Galaxea R1 Pro上的WVP,他们的相机配置在图3 a. 11 1后世,我们把弗兰卡·熊猫和Galaxea R1 Pro分别称为弗兰卡和加拉克西亚. 除非另有说明,所有实验都使用同一缝合的VGGT外形模拟器,如第4.2节所描述,无需再作进一步的微调. 视频生成器直接在Franka和Pipper-X上使用,并仅使用Galaxea上的目标任务的RGB录音来进行改编. 评估涵盖对Franka和Pipper-X的12个桌面操纵和对Galaxea的洗衣房操纵,包括取出和放置、打开、插入、抓取、堆放和擦拭。 这些任务构成不同的挑战。 取出一支笔和一个篮球需要不同的抓取状态. 打开洗衣机门或抽屉需要处理装订好的固定装置。 处理衣服和毛巾需要保持有效的控制,因为它们变形。

blocks.en: Across 10 trials per task, WVP achieves mean success rates of 72.5% on Galaxea, 52.5% on Franka, and 50.0% on PiPER-X (Fig. 3 b). These results show that a pose estimator trained on five public robot datasets can support manipulation across all three platforms without further fine-tuning, translating video predictions into executable motion across different tasks and scenes. The executions in Fig. 3 c further illustrate WVP’s behavior under challenging visual and manipulation conditions, as detailed below. • Manipulation in low light. Galaxea retrieves clothes from the floor and inside the washing machine, where the wrist views become dark during approach. Despite limited visibility, it grasps and retrieves the garments. • Fine-grained manipulation. Galaxea aligns its gripper with the washing machine’s recessed handle, while Franka engages the drawer handle before pulling. Franka also grasps a slender pen just above the tabletop, demonstrating precise gripper positioning. • Transparent-object manipulation. Franka picks up and stacks transparent bowls despite reflections and overlapping rims that obscure their boundaries in the wrist view. Across these conditions, the same pose estimator converts predicted wrist views into executable motion, supporting its reuse across diverse manipulation requirements. Please refer to the supplementary material for more videos.

blocks.en: Execution errors can leave the robot or manipulated objects in states that the original visual plan did not anticipate. By conditioning subsequent video predictions on new observations, WVP can adjust its approach and retry from these states. In Fig. 4 (top), PiPER-X closes its gripper too early and displaces the block instead of grasping it. From the updated wrist view, the generator predicts a new approach, and the robot reopens its gripper and grasps the block at its new position. In Fig. 4 (bottom), Galaxea initially misses the washing machine’s recessed handle, then backs away, realigns its gripper, and opens the door on the next attempt. Together, these examples show how closed-loop feedback and the video model’s ability to replan from out-of-distribution states enable WVP to correct execution deviations.
blocks.zh: 执行错误可以将机器人或被操纵的物体留在原视觉计划没有预料到的状态中. 通过在新的观测上对后续的视频预测进行调制,WVP可以调整其方法并从这些状态进行再试. 在图4(上)中,Pipper-X过早地关闭了它的抓取器并取代了块来代替取取取. 从更新的手腕视图来看,生成器预测了一个新的取向,机器人重新打开了取取器并抓住了被取出的新位置. 在图4(下方)中,加拉克西亚起初错过了洗衣机的倒置手柄,然后退后,调整了握手,并在下次尝试时打开了门。 这些例子共同显示了闭路反馈和视频模型从分配外状态进行再规划的能力,使得WVP能够纠正执行偏差.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Recovery from execution deviations. PiPER-X retries a grasp after displacing the block (top), and Galaxea realigns its gripper after missing the recessed door handle (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图4:从执行偏差中回收。 PiPER-X在取代了块(上部)后重试了抓取器,而Galaxea在错过了倒闭的门柄(下部)后重新调整了抓取器.

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison to Alternative Policies
blocks.zh: 5.2 与备选政策的比较

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Policy comparison on four Franka manipulation tasks. Each bar reports the success rate over 10 trials under the same evaluation conditions. Ours (VERA) and Ours (Cosmos3) pair the VERA-DROID and Cosmos3-Nano-DROID video backbones, respectively, with our stitched wrist-camera pose estimator.
blocks.zh: 图5:四个Franka操纵任务的政策比较。 每个律师协会报告在同样评价条件下10起审判的成功率。 我们的 " VERA " 和 " Ours (Cosmos3) " 分别配有VERA-DROID和Cosmos3-Nano-DROID的视频主干线,我们缝合的手腕相机则构成估计器。

blocks.en:
To compare how well different policies generalize across manipulation tasks, we compare WVP with baselines on the four Franka tasks from Sec. 5.1 . All methods use the same robot setup, camera configuration, and evaluation protocol. We pair our stitched pose estimator with the VERA-DROID video generator [ 29 ] without deployment-specific fine-tuning of either component, and use DROID-fine-tuned checkpoints for the baselines.
As shown in Fig. 5 ,
WVP substantially outperforms VERA and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 5 ] , while achieving performance comparable to Cosmos3-Nano-DROID [ 1 ] . With the same VERA-DROID video generator, our stitched pose estimator converts predicted wrist-camera motion into robot actions and achieves higher success rates than VERA’s Jacobian IDM on all four tasks. This result supports camera motion as an effective, reusable action representation that connects video prediction to robot control through shared geometric motion estimation.
blocks.zh:
为了比较不同的政策如何将操纵任务普遍化,我们把WVP与来自第5.1节的4个Franka任务的基线进行比较。 所有方法都使用相同的机器人设置,相机配置,以及评价协议. 我们用VERA-DROID的视频生成器配上我们缝合的姿势估计器[29],而不对其中任一部件进行具体部署的微调,并在基线上使用DROID-fine-counted检查站。
如图5所示,
WVP的性能大大超过VERA和 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5} [5],同时实现与Cosmos3-Nano-DROID[1]相仿的性能. 使用同一VERA-DROID的视频生成器,我们所缝合的姿势估计器将预想的手腕相机运动转换为机器人动作,并在所有四项任务上取得比VERA的雅各布IDM更高的成功率. 这个结果支持相机运动作为一种有效,可再用的行动表现,通过共享几何运动估计将视频预测与机器人控制相接.

blocks.en: We further test the applicability of this representation and the stitching approach by pairing WVP with the Cosmos3-Nano-DROID video backbone. Following Sec. 4.2 , we retrain the stitched pose estimator for the latent representation of the underlying Wan2.2 model, without further adaptation to the DROID-specific video checkpoint or the target embodiment. With the Cosmos3-Nano-DROID video backbone, WVP again outperforms the model’s original action head, extending the advantage of the camera-motion representation to a second video generator. This pairing also achieves higher success rates than our VERA-based policy, demonstrating that the stitching approach accommodates different video generators and allows their predictions to improve downstream execution. Together, these results support a scalable design in which wrist-camera motion serves as a shared action representation across video generators, and suggest that improvements in video prediction can translate into higher manipulation success rates through geometric motion estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步测试这种表述的适用性和缝合方法,将WVP与Cosmos3-Nano-DROID视频主干线配对. 继第4.2条之后,我们重新训练被缝合的图案,以说明Wan2.2模型的潜在代表性,而不进一步适应DROID特定的视频检查点或目标化。 随着Cosmos3-Nano-DROID的视频主干线,WVP再次超越了模型最初的动作头部,将相机动作表现的优势扩展到了第二个视频生成器. 这种对接也取得了比我们基于VERA的政策更高的成功率,表明缝合方法容纳了不同的视频生成器,并使得它们的预测可以改善下游的执行. 这些结果共同支持可伸缩设计,其中手腕相机运动作为视频生成器之间的共同动作代表,并表明视频预测的改进可以通过几何运动估计转化为更高的操纵成功率.

blocks.en: 5.3 Component Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 构成部分分析

blocks.en: We evaluate how video generation, pose-estimation backbones, pretrained initialization, pose supervision, and model stitching affect motion estimation and task execution.
blocks.zh: 我们评价视频生成、平面估计主干、预先训练初始化、监督、模型缝合如何影响运动估计和任务执行。

blocks.en: We evaluate six video generators on 256 clips spanning 12 tasks collected with PiPER Dual Arm. Following RoboJudge [ 35 ] , we assess Physical Adherence (PA), measuring physical plausibility, and Instruction Alignment (IA), measuring progress toward the instructed task. As shown in Tab. 1 , VERA scores highest on PA and Cosmos3 on IA. However, qualitative examples in the supplementary material show that VERA often makes little progress toward the goal, whereas Cosmos3 introduces substantial errors in scene content. Though VPP2 ranks second on both metrics, it achieves the best balance between physical faithfulness and task progression on PiPER.
blocks.zh: 我们用256个片段评估了六台录像发电机,这些片段跨越了PiPER双臂收集的12个任务。 继Robo Judge[35]之后,我们评估实际遵守情况(PA),衡量物理可信度,以及指令调整(IA),衡量执行指示任务的进展情况。 如塔布所显示. 1,VERA在PA和Cosmos3上得分最高. 然而,补充材料中的定性实例表明,VERA在实现目标方面往往进展甚微,而Cosmos3则在现场内容方面引入了重大错误。 尽管VPP2在两个度量标准上都排名第二,但它在PiPER上实现了物理忠诚度和任务进度的最佳平衡.

blocks.en: To assess how these prediction differences translate into execution, we pair each generator with its corresponding trained pose estimator and conduct ten trials of put the vegetable on the bread . The VPP2 pairing succeeds in 4/10 trials, compared with 1/10 for VERA and 0/10 for the other generators. Nevertheless, generator performance varies across deployment settings. We use VPP2 on PiPER-X and VERA-DROID on Franka, where it outperforms VPP2 in our trials. Neither generator performs well on the Galaxea laundry tasks without adaptation, so we fine-tune VERA using only RGB recordings from that setting.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这些预测差异是如何转化为执行的,我们把每台发电机配以经过相应训练的外观模型,并进行十次将蔬菜放入面包的试验。 VPP2对接在4/10的试验中成功,而VERA为1/10,而其他发电机为0/10. 尽管如此,发电机的性能因部署环境而异。 我们用VPP2在PiPER-X上,用VERA-DROID在Franka上,它在我们的试验中表现优于VPP2. 发电机在加拉克西亚洗衣机任务上都表现良好,没有经过改造,所以我们只使用从那个场合的RGB录音来微调VERA.

blocks.en: We evaluate six pose estimators on wrist-camera videos from 1,000 held-out Galaxea episodes. The laundry-room environment is absent from all five fine-tuning datasets, allowing us to assess transfer to an unseen scene. We convert predicted camera poses to end-effector poses and compute errors against the recorded poses. As shown in Tab. 2 , all six pretrained models exhibit substantial pose errors, and fine-tuning under the shared wrist-camera formulation (Sec. 4.1 ) reduces both translation and rotation errors. These results highlight the importance of fine-tuning pretrained 3D models on robot data for wrist-camera motion estimation. Fine-tuned VGGT achieves the lowest translation RMSE, rotation RMSE, and gripper MAE, making it our default backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们从一千个被搁置的加拉克西亚片段 评估出六幅手腕相机的画面 所有五个微调数据集都缺少洗衣房环境,使我们能够评估转移到一个看不见的场景的情况。 我们把预测的相机姿势转换成末端效相机姿势,并根据记录的姿势计算出错误. 如Tab. 2所显示的,所有6个预先训练过的模型都显示出很大的出错,在共享手腕-相机配方(Sec 4.1)下进行微调可以减少翻译和旋转出错. 这些结果凸显出在机器人数据上微调预先训练的3D模型对腕相机运动估计的重要性. 微调VGGT实现最低的翻译RMSE,旋转RMSE,和抓取MAE,成为了我们的默认骨干.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Effect of pretraining and pose supervision on Galaxea pose estimation. Rand init replaces pretrained initialization with random weights; EE-pose replaces wrist-camera supervision with end-effector poses.
blocks.zh: 图7:预训的影响和对加拉克西亚的监管形成估计。 Rand init以随机权重取代了被预先训练的初始化;EE-pose以终端效应器外观取代了手腕-相机监督.

blocks.en: We investigate two design choices for training the VGGT expert: pretrained versus random initialization, and wrist-camera versus end-effector poses as supervision targets. As shown in Fig. 7 , random initialization leads to substantially higher translation and rotation errors than pretrained initialization, supporting the use of pretrained 3D priors for wrist-camera motion estimation. Supervising the model with wrist-camera poses also yields more accurate trajectories than using end-effector poses. Wrist-camera supervision retains the camera-pose estimation task used in VGGT pretraining and provides a common geometric target across all five datasets. This formulation avoids learning embodiment-specific calibration. Together, these results support combining pretrained 3D priors with wrist-camera supervision to learn accurate motion estimation from heterogeneous robot data.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了培训VGGT专家的两种设计选择:预先培训与随机初始化,手腕相机与终端效应器构成监督目标。 如图7所显示,随机初始化导致翻译和旋转出错大大高于预受训练初始化,支持使用预受训练的3D前作进行腕相机运动估计. 用手腕相机来监督模型,也产生出比使用端效相机外观更准确的轨迹. Wrist-camera监理保留了VGGT预训中使用的相机-pose估计任务,提供了所有五个数据集的共同几何目标. 这种配方避免了学习特异性地分解. 这些结果共同支持将预先训练的3D前科和手腕-相机监督结合起来,以学习从多样的机器人数据中准确的运动估计.

blocks.en: To assess how model stitching affects action recovery, we compare trajectories from the same video prediction using the trained RGB expert on decoded frames and the stitched estimator on predicted latents. The predicted wrist views show an approach toward the lettuce (Fig. 6 a). The RGB expert recovers a mostly forward trajectory with insufficient descent, whereas the stitched estimator captures the downward motion needed to reach the lettuce (Fig. 6 b). Executing the stitched trajectory brings the gripper to the lettuce, with wrist views closely matching the predicted approach (Fig. 6 a, bottom). On PiPER-X, the stitched estimator achieves 40% success on put the vegetable on the bread , compared with 0% for the RGB expert (Fig. 6 b). Together, these results show that a plausible visual plan can be poorly translated by RGB-based pose estimation. By recovering motion more consistent with the visual plan and improving task execution, model stitching provides an effective interface between video prediction and robot control without intermediate RGB decoding.
blocks.zh: 为了评估模型缝合如何影响动作恢复,我们利用受过解码框架培训的RGB专家与被缝合的预测器,比较了同一视频预测的轨迹。 所预测的手腕视图显示对生菜的一种取向(图6a)。 RGB专家在下降不足的情况下恢复了多为前向的轨迹,而被缝合的估测器则捕捉到去向生菜所需的向下运动(图6b). 执行被缝接的轨迹会把抓取者带到生菜上,手腕视图与所预测的方法(图6 a,下方)紧密相匹配. 在PiPER-X上,缝合的估测器在将蔬菜放入面包上上取得了40%的成功,而RGB专家则取得了0%的成功(图6b). 这些结果显示,基于RGB的可视化计划可能翻译不当。 通过恢复运动更符合视觉计划并改进任务执行,模型缝合提供了视频预测和机器人控制之间的有效接口,没有中间RGB解码.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a policy that decouples task prediction from motion execution through wrist-camera motion. A video model predicts how a task unfolds, while a 3D pose estimator translates those predictions into actions through a shared geometric formulation. Trained on public robot data, the estimator transfers across three platforms without further fine-tuning. Comparisons with VERA and Cosmos3 show higher task success with our pose estimator and gains from switching video generators. This separation offers a scalable path to generalist manipulation: task knowledge can expand through large-scale video learning while geometric motion estimation remains reusable across tasks and embodiments, allowing advances in video prediction to improve robot control without new action-labeled demonstrations for real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Wrist Video Policy(WVP),这个政策通过手腕-相机运动将任务预测与动作执行脱钩. 一个视频模型可以预测一个任务是如何展开的,而一个3D的平面模型通过一个共享的几何配方将这些预测转化为行动. 接受公共机器人数据培训,估算器跨出3个平台而无需再进行微调. 与VERA和Cosmos3的比较表明,任务的成功程度较高,我们的姿势估计器和转换视频发电机的收益较高。 这种分离为通论操纵提供了可伸缩的路径:任务知识可以通过大规模视频学习来扩展,而几何运动估计仍然可以跨任务和浮出水面重复使用,使得视频预测的进步可以改善机器人控制而无需为现实世界的部署提供新的行动标签演示.

blocks.en: We train the RGB pose estimator and its stitched variants using the five public datasets described in Tab. 3 . The training configuration is summarized in Tab. 4 . Both stages use the same robot videos, with dataset annotations supervising the RGB expert and the frozen expert providing targets for distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Tab中描述的五个公共数据集,来训练RGB的外观模型及其缝合变体。 3 培训配置摘要载于Tab。 4. 两个阶段都使用相同的机器人视频,数据集说明监督RGB专家和被冻结的专家提供分馏目标.

blocks.en: We sample 17-frame clips at a randomly selected observation frequency between 2 and 10 Hz. The RGB expert takes five anchor frames at indices { 0 , 4 , 8 , 12 , 16 } \{0,4,8,12,16\} , each resized to 224 × 280 224\times 280 pixels. For stitching, the frozen Wan VAE [ 48 ] encodes the full clip with fourfold temporal compression. The first frame produces the initial latent, and every four subsequent frames produce one additional latent time step, yielding five latent time steps from 17 RGB frames. We align the pose and gripper targets with the five anchor frames. VAE preprocessing follows the corresponding video generator. For VERA [ 29 ] , each view is resized to 128 × 192 128\times 192 and encoded separately. For VPP2 [ 20 ] , the views are tiled into a single 240 × 416 240\times 416 image before VAE encoding. All image dimensions are reported as height × \times width.
blocks.zh: 我们在2至10赫兹之间随机选择的观测频率上 抽取了17帧的剪接 RGB专家取出5个主锚框,分别取取入0,4,8,12,16等指数,取出0,4,8,12,16等指数,每组被调整为224×280224相280像素. 为了缝合,被冷冻的Wan VAE [48]用4倍时间压缩来编码整段剪辑. 第一个框架产生初始潜伏,其后每四个框架产生一个额外的潜伏时间步骤,从17个RGB框架产生出五个潜伏的时间步骤. 我们把姿势和扳手目标与五个锚架一致。 VAE预处理遵循相应的视频生成器. 对于VERA [29],每个视图被调整为128×192128\times 192并单独编码. 对于VPP2 [20],在VAE编码之前,视图被平铺为单相240×416240\tims 416图像. 所有图像维度都报告为高度×\times宽度.

blocks.en: We initialize the backbone and camera head from the official pretrained VGGT [ 49 ] weights and jointly optimize them with the gripper head. Camera supervision uses VGGT’s multi-stage L 1 L_{1} loss on translation and rotation, with equal weights for the two terms and a stage decay factor of 0.6 0.6 . Focal-length supervision is disabled. The gripper head predicts continuous gripper opening normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and is supervised with a smooth L 1 L_{1} loss. The camera and gripper losses receive weights of 5.0 5.0 and 0.1 0.1 , respectively. We use the checkpoint obtained after 50,000 minibatch iterations.
blocks.zh: 我们从官方预训的VGGT[49]重量上初始化骨干和相机头并用钳头来联合优化. 相机监听使用VGGT的多相L 1 LQQ1}在翻译和旋转时丢失,两个术语的权重相同,相机衰减系数为0.6 0.6. 焦距监督被禁用. 抓取器头会预测连续抓取器开口正常化为 [0, 1] [0, 1] 并被监督为平滑的L 1 LQQQ1}损失. 相机和抓取器的损耗分别得到5.0 5.0和0.1 . 我们使用经过5万次小批量重复后得到的检查站.

blocks.en:
After probing, the fifth block of the VGGT backbone yields the least error, because of which we select it as our stitch point.
The video latents are connected to the expert’s image-encoder features using a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional adapter with 1,024 output channels. The retained backbone and prediction heads are initialized from the RGB expert. During distillation, the expert processes the original wrist-camera frames and the student processes their corresponding VAE latents. The expert and VAE remain frozen, while the adapter, retained backbone, and prediction heads are jointly optimized for 10,000 minibatch iterations. Camera predictions are distilled using the same multi-stage pose loss, and the student’s sigmoid gripper predictions are matched to the expert’s predicted gripper openings using a smooth L 1 L_{1} loss. We also apply latent noise augmentation with a maximum noise standard deviation of 0.2 0.2 . The student uses BF16 mixed precision, while the frozen expert runs in FP32.
blocks.zh:
经过探险,VGGT主干线的第五块产生最小的错误,因此我们选择它作为我们的缝接点.
视频潜入器与专家的图像编码器功能相接,使用1×1 1\times 1 转式适配器,输出频道为1,024个. 所保留的骨干和预测头由RGB专家初始化. 在蒸馏过程中,专家处理原始手腕-相机相框,学生处理相应的VAE潜伏. 专家与VAE仍被冷冻,而适配器,保留了骨干,预测头被联合优化为一万个小批迭代. 相机预测使用相同的多相相机进行分馏,学生所预测的相机抓取器与专家所预测的接取器开口相匹配,使用平滑的L 1 LQQQ1}相接. 我们还采用潜在噪声增强法,最大噪声标准偏差为0.2.2. 学生使用BF16混合精度,而被冻结的专家运行于FP32.

blocks.en: Table 5: Task instructions and execution horizons. For each task, we list the exact instruction provided to the policy and the number of actions executed before replanning.
blocks.zh: 表5:任务指示和执行范围。 就每项任务而言,我们列出对政策的确切指示以及在重新规划之前执行的行动的数目。

blocks.en: We list our specific prompts and action execution steps in Tab. 5 . At each planning step, the policy predicts wrist-camera pose increments and gripper states. We convert these increments into end-effector targets using hand-eye calibration and execute the specified number of actions before replanning.
blocks.zh: 我们在Tab中列出具体的提示和行动执行步骤. 5. 在每个规划步骤中,政策预测手腕相机会产生增量和收缩状态。 我们使用手眼校准,将这些增量转换成最终效果目标,并在重新规划前执行特定数量的行动.

blocks.en: We accumulate the predicted motion increments from the measured end-effector poses to obtain target trajectories for both arms. Positions are linearly interpolated, while orientations are interpolated using spherical linear interpolation. RelaxedIK converts the interpolated targets into joint configurations for each arm. The mobile base remains stationary during execution.
blocks.zh: 我们从测定的末端效应器上积累了预测的运动增量,以获得两臂的目标轨迹。 位置被线性内插,而取向则使用球状线性内插. relaxedIK将插入的目标转换为每个臂的联合配置. 流动基地在执行期间保持不变。

blocks.en: We convert the predicted wrist-camera motion into arm targets and compute joint configurations using numerical inverse kinematics. We use Pinocchio for kinematic computations, with bounded nonlinear least-squares optimization for Franka and damped least-squares iterations for PiPER-X. The resulting joint targets are interpolated with quintic polynomials and executed together with the predicted gripper commands.
blocks.zh: 我们把预想的手腕相机运动转换成手臂目标,并使用数字反相动来计算联合配置. 我们用皮诺克奇奥进行动能计算,Franka的有界非线性最小平方优化,而PiPER-X的有界性最小平方重迭. 由此而来的联合目标被插入了五分位多音符并连同预测的抓取命令一起被执行.

blocks.en: We compare the RGB expert and stitched VGGT on recorded videos from the same Galaxea benchmark. As shown in Tab. 6 , the RGB expert achieves lower errors across all three metrics. The execution gains from stitching therefore cannot be attributed to better estimation accuracy on recorded videos. Fig. 8 further compares the generated wrist views with observations recorded during execution of the stitched trajectories. Across the three examples, the robot closely follows the predicted approach and grasping motions, even when the generated images contain blur or distorted object shapes. For example, in put the chicken wing on the plate , the generated chicken wing becomes distorted as the gripper closes, while the robot executes the corresponding grasp on the real object. In put the basketball in the basket , the predicted basket has a visibly different contour from the real one, yet the executed motion follows the approach shown in the prediction. Together with the offline comparison, these examples support the benefit of model stitching, which allows the pose estimator to recover executable motion directly from predicted latents despite visible artifacts in the decoded video.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了 RGB 专家 和缝合 VGGT 在录制视频 从同一 加拉克西亚基准。 如塔布所显示. 6,RGB专家在所有三个度量标准上实现了较低的出错. 因此,缝合的执行收益不能归因于对所录录相带的准确性有了更好的估计。 图8进一步将所生成的手腕视图与执行被缝合出轨迹时所记录的观测结果进行比较. 在整个三个例子中,机器人紧密地遵循了预测的方法并抓住了运动,即使生成的图像包含模糊或被扭曲的物体形状. 例如,在将鸡翅放入盘子中,产生的鸡翅会随着抓取器的关闭而变得被扭曲,而机器人则对真实物体执行相应的抓取. 将篮子放在篮子中, 预测篮子的轮廓与真实篮子明显不同, 与离线比较一起,这些例子支持了模型缝合的好处,这使得姿势估计器可以直接从预想的潜伏中恢复可执行的运动,尽管解码视频中有可见的文物.

blocks.en: All six models receive the same instruction and initial global and wrist views. They generate the three views jointly, using the input format appropriate to each generator. VERA-OMNI [ 29 ] encodes each view separately and arranges the latents in its native multi-view format. VPP2 [ 20 ] arranges the input views into a single image. For Wan2.1 [ 48 ] and LVP [ 10 ] , we encode the three views separately and concatenate the latents along their width. blocks.en: We use RoboJudge-9B [ 35 ] to evaluate Physical Adherence (PA) and Instruction Alignment (IA). PA measures whether the robot and objects remain consistent over time and whether motion and contact are physically plausible. IA measures whether the intended manipulator acts on the correct object and how much of the requested task is visibly completed.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Robo Judge-9B[35]来评估实际遵守和指令一致。 巴勒斯坦权力机构衡量机器人和物体在一段时间内是否保持一致,以及运动和接触在物理上是否合理。 IA衡量预期操纵者是否在正确的物体上行事,以及所要求的任务有多少明显完成。

blocks.en: We concatenate the synchronized wrist views side by side and label each camera, prompting the judge to assess them as complementary views of a single execution. This allows an object to leave one view while remaining visible in the other, and one arm to complete the task while the other remains still. We make two calls per clip: PA is evaluated without the instruction, while IA additionally receives the instruction and uses the first frame as the initial scene. Each call returns an integer score from 1 to 5 with supporting visual evidence. We report mean PA and IA separately over all 256 clips. The evaluation prompts are reproduced in Fig. 11 .
blocks.zh: 我们把手腕同步的视线 并列并标注每个相机, 促使法官评估它们 作为互补的视角 一次处决。 这使得一个对象可以离开一个视图,同时在另一个视图中保持可见,而一个臂则可以完成任务,而另一个则仍然不变. 我们每个片段打两次电话: PA在没有指令的情况下进行评估,而IA额外接收了指令并使用第一帧作为初始场景. 每一次调用都会带辅助视觉证据返回从1到5的整数分. 我们报告,在所有256个片段中,PA和IA是分开的。 图11转载了评价提示。

blocks.en: RoboJudge scores only the generated video. To evaluate execution, we train a corresponding pose estimator for each of the six generators. We pair each generator with a pose estimator trained in its corresponding VAE latent space. VERA-OMNI, VPP2, Wan2.1, LVP, and Cosmos Predict2.5 use the Wan2.1 VAE, while Cosmos3 uses the Wan2.2 VAE. For each pairing, training inputs follow the generator’s view arrangement and VAE preprocessing described above, so the estimator receives the same latent format during training and inference.
blocks.zh: RoboJudge只给生成的视频评分. 为了评估执行情况,我们为六台发电机中的每一台都培训了一个相应的定位估计器。 我们给每个发电机配上一个姿势估测器,在相应的 VAE 潜在空间中训练。 VERA-OMNI,VPP2,Wan2.1,LVP,和宇宙预测2.5使用Wan2.1 VAE,而Cosmos3使用Wan2.2 VAE. 对于每次对接,培训投入都遵循发电机的视图安排和上文所述的VAE预处理,因此估计器在培训和推断期间得到相同的潜在格式。

blocks.en: 12 Details on Video Model Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 12 视频模型精细调整的细节

blocks.en: We collect synchronized multi-view RGB videos with Galaxea R1 Pro in a laundry-room setting, covering washing-machine door operation, loading and retrieving clothes, and handling laundry baskets and bags.
blocks.zh: 我们收集与Galaxea R1 Pro在洗衣房设置中的同步多视图RGB视频,涵盖洗衣机门操作,装入并取回衣服,处理洗衣篮和包.

blocks.en: We fine-tune the video generator following VERA’s training procedure [ 29 ] , initializing from its released VERA-OMNI checkpoint based on Wan2.1-I2V-14B. Each training sample contains 37 frames sampled with a stride of two, corresponding to 15 Hz for recordings at 30 fps. The inputs comprise two head-camera views and two wrist-camera views, each resized to 128 × 192 128\times 192 . We encode each view separately with the frozen VAE and concatenate the resulting latents. Following Diffusion Forcing, we randomly vary the history length from one to six latent time steps and predict four future latent steps, conditioned on the task instruction, CLIP image features, and historical latents. The DiT is trained with an MSE flow-matching loss whose target is the difference between the sampled noise and the clean video latents.
blocks.zh: 依据Wan2.1-I2V-14B的VERA-OMNI检查站, 每个训练样本中包含37个被取样的帧并有2个阶梯,对应15个Hz,用于30英尺高的录音. 投入包括两幅相机取景和两幅相机取景,每幅相机取景量被调整为128×192128相机取景. 我们将每个视图与被冻结的VAE分别编码,并凝固由此产生的潜伏. 在扩散强化之后,我们随机地将历史长度从1到6个潜在时间步骤相去甚远,并预测未来4个潜在步骤,它们以任务指令、CLIP图像特征和历史潜伏为条件。 DiT被训练为MSE流相匹配损失,目标是被取样的噪音与干净的视频潜伏的区别.

blocks.en: We fine-tune all DiT parameters while freezing the VAE, text encoder, and CLIP image encoder. Training runs for 6,000 optimizer steps on eight GPUs using FSDP and BF16 precision, with a batch size of 20 per GPU and a global batch size of 160. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , betas of ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) , and weight decay of 0.05 0.05 . The learning rate warms up over the first 1,000 steps and remains constant thereafter.
blocks.zh: 我们微调所有DiT参数,同时冻结了VAE,文本编码器和CLIP图像编码器. 使用FSDP和BF16精度对8个GPU进行6000个优化步骤的培训,分批大小为每GPU20个,全球分批大小为160个. 我们使用 AdamW 的学习率为 10 - 5 10 - 5 }, β 为 (0.9, 0.95), 体重衰减为 0.05 0.05 。 在最初的1 000个步骤中,学习率有所上升,此后保持不变。

blocks.en: 13 Details on Pose Estimator Evaluation
blocks.zh: 13 关于Pose估计评价的细节

blocks.en:
We construct an offline pose estimation benchmark from 1,000 Galaxea R1 Pro episodes sampled from the dataset discussed in Sec. 12 . The laundry-room environment is absent from the five public datasets used to train the pose estimators. Each episode provides synchronized wrist-camera images, recorded end-effector poses, gripper states, and hand-eye calibrations, allowing us to evaluate motion estimation in an unseen environment.
For each episode, we fix a randomly selected starting frame and sample five synchronized pairs of wrist-camera images at offsets of { 0 , 24 , 48 , 72 , 96 } \{0,24,48,72,96\} frames. At 30 fps, this corresponds to sampling at 5 Hz with an anchor stride of four, consistent with our training setup. All models receive the same images at the same time points, resized to their respective input resolutions.

blocks.en: 14 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 14 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The inference latency of video models such as VERA and VPP2 limits the efficiency of real-world deployment, as the robot must wait for new predictions between action segments (Tab. 7 ). Executing longer action segments reduces the number of inference calls but also limits opportunities for feedback correction, as shown in Fig. 9 . Accelerating the video generator through one-step distillation [ 41 , 20 ] could enable more frequent replanning while reducing waiting time.
blocks.zh: VERA和VPP2等视频模型的推论延迟限制了现实世界部署的效率,因为机器人必须在动作段间等待新的预测(Tab. 7. 如图所示,执行较长的动作段会减少推断呼叫的次数,但也限制了反馈更正的机会. 9 (中文(简体) ). 通过分步蒸馏加速视频生成器[41,20]可以使规划更频繁,同时减少等待时间.

blocks.en: Motion estimation becomes challenging when a manipulated object occupies most of the wrist-camera view. For example, when handling a large bowl, the camera may observe mainly the bowl rather than the surrounding scene. As the bowl moves together with the gripper, its appearance provides limited evidence of camera motion relative to the environment. Incorporating auxiliary views into the pose estimator could provide complementary geometric cues and improve robustness to such occlusions.
blocks.zh: 当被操纵的物体占据了手腕-相机视图的大部分时,运动估计就变得具有挑战性. 例如,在处理一大碗时,相机可能主要观察碗而不是周围的场景. 随着碗与钳子一起移动,它的外观提供了相对于环境的相机运动的有限证据. 将辅助观点纳入姿势估计器可以提供补充几何提示,并增强这种隔离的强度。

blocks.en: Inaccuracies in video prediction are a major factor limiting execution success. Despite their broad generalization capabilities, video generators can still predict slightly incorrect viewpoints or spatial relationships, such as the gripper’s height relative to an object. These deviations can lead to unsuccessful execution even when the pose estimator faithfully recovers the predicted motion. Improving the geometric accuracy of video predictions is therefore an important direction for increasing manipulation reliability.
blocks.zh: 视频预测不准确是限制执行成功的主要因素. 尽管具有广泛的通俗化能力,视频生成器仍能预测出略微不正确的观点或空间关系,例如抓取者相对于物体的高度. 即使姿势估计器忠实地恢复了预测的运动,这些偏差也可能导致执行失败. 因此,提高视频预测的几何精度是提高操纵可靠性的重要方向.

blocks.en: Our evaluation does not yet cover highly precise operations such as screw driving, more complex bimanual coordination, or tasks involving large rotations. Pose estimation errors may become more consequential in these settings, where successful execution requires tighter positional and rotational accuracy. Future work could explore these tasks and further investigate few-shot adaptation of the video generator and pose estimator to improve precision and coordination with additional fine-tuning data.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价尚未涵盖螺丝驱动、更复杂的双人协调或涉及大规模轮换的任务等高度精确的操作。 在这些环境中,如果成功执行,需要更严格的定位和旋转准确性,那么便有可能出现更严重的估计错误。 今后的工作可以探讨这些任务,并进一步调查录像生成器的几发改编情况,并作出估计,以便改进精确度,并与更多的微调数据相协调。

blocks.zh: 15 其他可视化

blocks.en: Fig. 12 and Fig. 13 present additional real-world executions on Franka and PiPER-X, extending the task and object coverage shown in the main paper. These examples further illustrate the following capabilities: • Diverse manipulation skills. The tasks extend beyond pick-and-place to towel folding, plug insertion and removal, and tool use such as pouring water from a kettle. • Fine-grained manipulation of varied objects. The examples cover objects with different shapes, sizes, and materials, including cups, food items, and towels. Small objects, such as bottle caps, coffee stirrers, and chopsticks, further require precise manipulation. • Bimanual coordination. The two arms perform complementary actions when placing bread on a plate and subsequently placing a vegetable on the bread. Lifting a basket by both handles additionally requires the arms to coordinate their grasps and lifting motions.
blocks.zh: 图12和图13对Franka和PiPER-X进行了更多的真实世界处决,扩大了主要文件所示的任务和对象范围。 这些例子进一步说明了以下能力: ——不同操纵技能. 任务范围超越取地到毛巾折叠,插入和去除,以及从水壶倒入水等工具. • 精心操纵各种物体。 例子包括形状、大小和材料不同的物体,包括杯子、食品和毛巾。 小型物体,如瓶盖,咖啡搅拌器,以及筷子等,进一步需要精确地被操纵. • 双人协调。 这两只手臂在将面包放入盘子后,在面包上放入蔬菜时,会起到补充作用。 双手举起一篮子还需要武器协调其抓取和起动。
